limits: Synthetic trees and child processes only. No image, installed service, application, radio, screen or SD is accessed.
Cooperative flock primitive only; unguarded entry points are not blocked by this module.
The attempted latch prevents another factory attempt in the same fixture after a crash. A real reboot and fresh /run are not tested.
Ready is a generic assertion. Hook success, candidate pins, worker cgroup quiescence and boot provenance require a separate supervisor and are not established here.
A late Ready publication error may leave a complete marker accepted by a reader; it is an uncertain response, not revocation.

Leases retained across dup and fork are exercised. Installed exec wrappers, inherited descriptors across application children, real service drains and NetworkManager or physical display quiescence remain unqualified.
macOS substitutes fixture ownership and the xattr API. Linux root exercises UID/GID 1000 reads and refusal of state creation with the real APIs.

macos.skip_reason: Three tests require Linux root and real numeric ownership.
